description: Unified controls catalog for CyberAI Assessment Platform

critical.description: Controls that are fundamental to information security. Failure to implement creates immediate high-risk exposure.

high.description: Controls that significantly reduce risk. Failure creates substantial vulnerability.

medium.description: Controls that provide good security posture. Important but not immediately critical.

low.description: Controls that enhance security posture. Nice-to-have but not urgent.

satisfied.description: Control is fully implemented with adequate evidence.

partial.description: Control is partially implemented or evidence is incomplete.

missing.description: Control is not implemented or no evidence provided.

not_applicable.description: Control is not applicable to the organization's context.
